summary: @servicetitan/hammer-react preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated credential-harvesting payload
details: package.json declares `scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs"`. setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style renamed code that downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts the `bun` binary, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync`. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line bundle with a rotated string-array (`WV8StW` shuffle) and numeric-index string decoder (`hc1jfK9`) — the obfuscator.io fingerprint. The bundle is not referenced by the library entry (dist/index.js) and does not correspond to any visible source in the tarball. String extraction across math_init.js surfaces multiple `.aws` occurrences consistent with reading installer AWS credential material at `~/.aws/credentials` / `~/.aws/config`. The install-time dropper + obfuscated sibling + `.aws` path references are grafted onto an otherwise ordinary React design-system tarball, consistent with a namespace hijack or impersonation of the ServiceTitan scope. Running `npm install @servicetitan/hammer-react` executes the obfuscated payload under an alternate runtime with the installer's user privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
